comment: Self-identification answers, worded as the EEO-1 report, the VEVRAA protected-veteran form and form CC-305 word them (US government works, public domain), plus the variants job sites use. Value ids are the profile's lists (GENDERS, RACES in src/core/enums.ts; yes and no; the veteran classifications). 'derived' marks a value the profile never stores: 'Two or More Races' and a race list's 'Hispanic or Latino' are chosen only by interpretation 2, which is off until the owner turns it on. 'decline' holds a question's own decline wording; the generic phrases in decline.json apply to every question. Sexual orientation and transgender identity have decline phrases only, because the profile holds no answer for them yet.
